      Read Me

      Bonkheads

      An earthquake has torn a rift from the surface all the way down to Trollsville, and pests are pouring in. Grag and Thog Bonkheads, armed only with rock-solid craniums, have to clear all twelve underworlds: 144 levels, with a boss every sixth level.

      How to play

      Pests walk in at the top corners and make their way down the platforms. To knock one off: get under it, bump the block it is standing on with your head, and it flies up and lands on its back. Then run into it to kick it off. Do it quickly, because it wakes back up (bump it again and it gets up straight away), and touching a pest that is awake costs you a troll.

      Bonk them before they reach the bottom: there's nothing under the floor to bump, so pests down there walk out through the passage at the side and come back in at the top, a little angrier. The TNT box knocks over every pest that is standing on something (pests in the air aren't affected, and any that are already out cold wake up). It has three uses for the whole game, so save it for when you need it; a Blastidian gem fills it up again.

      Bumping a block now and then knocks a gem out of it. You can steer in the air, and if you jump against a wall you can grab the top and climb up onto it. You get an extra troll every 5,000 points. Clear every pest to finish the level. Between levels Huntho, the wise old troll, gives you advice on the WORLDS screen, where you can save your game and load it later from the main menu.

      Each world plays a little differently: Waterville is underwater (slow, floaty jumps), Iceville's blocks are slippery and hard to see, and the pests in Moltenville are quicker.

            Difficulty and captions

            Options › Difficulty: Easy gives you more trolls, slower pests and longer naps; Hard has faster pests that wake up sooner. The game always starts on Medium with captions off. Turn on Options › Captions & descriptions to see Huntho's advice at the start of each level.

            Playing online

            Choose Game › Play Online… (or press O, or pick ONLINE on the main menu). Everyone who's been in the Arcade is on your Players list. Anyone sitting on a game's menu can be joined with one click: their game opens for you, no codes and no hosting first. Click someone to join them, or invite them to yours. The host's computer runs the game, so it plays the same for both of you.

            Battle mode

            Game › Battle… (or press B on the main menu) and pick a mode, how many trolls (2 to 4) and how many of them the computer plays. There are no pests, just trolls, in a random arena each round. The first troll to win 3 rounds takes the match.

            Fighting: bonk the block under a troll to flip him onto his back, then run into him to boot him: he goes flying and bowls over anyone in the way. Land on a troll's head to bounce off and daze him for a second. Flip two or three trolls with one bonk (chain reactions count) for a DOUBLE or TRIPLE BONK. The TNT box flips everybody else.

            Modes: Last Troll Standing: three lives each; out of lives, you come back as a ghost who can float through blocks and bump one every 10 seconds (jump). After 90 seconds tires start falling, and after 2 minutes it's sudden death: the floor turns to lava and the lowest blocks crumble away every 10 seconds. King of the Ledge: stand on the glowing gold ledge to score; it moves every 20 seconds; first to 30. TNT Hot Potato: whoever holds the lit dynamite passes it on by touching or bonking someone, and loses a troll if it goes off in his hands.

            Power-ups come out of blocks: Adrenalide (speed, and a flat-out run shoves trolls aside), Tranquilium (everyone else in slow motion), Densidian (can't jump, can't be flipped), Kryptoleum (touch a troll to knock him out), Blastidian (a stick of dynamite: press ↓ to throw it), Resurrectite (an extra troll). Mystery crystals can be any of them, or a curse that swaps left and right.

            4-player preview

            Press 4 on the main menu to see what a four-player game would look like. Grag and Thog play as usual, and two more trolls join in as computer buddies.

            Bonkheads was made by 1AM Entertainment in 1998. The pictures here are the game's own sprites; the levels and rules were worked out from a full walkthrough video.
